QuestionStmt.S:
Identify the product '$Z$' in the following series of reactions.

Ethanol $\xrightarrow{\mathrm{SOCl_2, \Delta}}$ X $\xrightarrow{\mathrm{Mg/dry\ ether}}$ Y $\xrightarrow{\mathrm{NH_3}}$ Z

Solution.S:
Step 1: Ethanol reacts with SOCl₂ to form ethyl chloride (X).
$$\mathrm{C_2H_5OH + SOCl_2 \xrightarrow{\Delta} C_2H_5Cl + SO_2 + HCl}$$

Step 2: Ethyl chloride reacts with Mg in dry ether to form ethyl magnesium chloride (Grignard reagent, Y).
$$\mathrm{C_2H_5Cl + Mg \xrightarrow{dry\ ether} C_2H_5MgCl}$$

Step 3: Grignard reagent reacts with ammonia (NH₃) to give ethane (Z) and MgNHCl.
$$\mathrm{C_2H_5MgCl + NH_3 \rightarrow C_2H_6 + MgNHCl}$$

Thus the final product Z is ethane, corresponding to option D.
